blocks.tamil_translation: “The leader of a travelling group (Jama'ah) is the servant of that group. Whoever gets ahead of his companions in serving, his companions cannot get ahead of him by any deed except sacrificing their lives (Shahadah)!” The greatest deed of all is Shahadah (dying as a martyr), and after it Khidmah (serving),” Hazrat Sahl ibn Sa'd (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْجَمَاعَةُ رَحْمَةٌ وَالْفُرْقَةُ عَذَابٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه عبد الله بن احمد والبزار والطبراني ورجالهم ثقات، مجمع الزوائد:٩٢/٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “(Staying together with) the Jama'ah is mercy (rahmah), and separating from the Jama'ah is punishment,” Hazrat Nu'man ibn Bashir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَُمَرَ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي الْوَحْدَةِ مَا أَعْلَمُ مَا سَارَ رَاكِبٌ بِلَيْلٍ وَحْدَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب السير وحده، رقم: ٢٩٩٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “If people knew, as I know, the (worldly and religious) consequences of travelling alone, no one would dare to travel all alone at night,” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: عَلَيْكُمْ بِالدُّلْجَةِ، فَإِنَّ اْلاَرْضَ تُطْوَي بِاللَّيْلِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في الدلجة، رقم:٢٥٧١
